assumptions: The exact preconditioned map has Euclidean lower margin mu.
The additive computation error has operator-2 upper margin eta.
The perturbation margin eta is strictly smaller than mu.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p07_t1_perturbed_preconditioned_map_injective {m n : Nat} (Y DeltaY : Fin m -> Fin n -> Real) (mu eta : Real) ... : Function.Injective (p07MatVec (Y + DeltaY))
formal_statement.plain_language: An additive perturbation strictly smaller than a matrix's Euclidean lower margin preserves full column rank.

informal_proof: Apply the exact frozen strict-perturbation injectivity theorem. Independently, subtract two equal outputs, split the perturbed action, and contradict eta < mu unless the input difference has zero Euclidean norm.
informal_statement: The full-rank conclusion of Lemma 3.2 in lower/upper vector-action form.
